messages:
Jules: Heads-up: third-party pentest scheduled Fri 2026-08-06 09:00-15:30 UTC. Need RBAC freeze window, KMS decrypt-proxy plan (no raw key export), immutable audit snapshot, and a single evidence owner. Volunteers?

Sam: I can own RBAC freeze + rollback playbook. Suggest freeze 08:30-16:00 UTC to allow pre/post ops. I'll enumerate service roles and list changes to apply.

Akira: I'll design the KMS proxy. Pattern: assessor assumes ephemeral role in their acct, Lambda verifies object path and calls KMS:Decrypt, response streamed to presigned URL. No key ARNs handed off. Need assessor account ID + allowed prefixes.

Maya: Platform: we need a verified, write-once snapshot of CloudTrail + host logs for the window and a sha256 checksum. Can we deliver via presigned readroom link? Retention 60 days.

Infra Bot: Created ticket SEC-PT-7340: RBAC freeze + KMS-proxy + readroom snapshot. Assigned @Sam, @Akira, @Maya. ETA: initial artifacts 48h.

Sam: RBAC snippet (will scope to exact ARNs):

```
{ "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Deny", "Action": ["iam:CreateRole","iam:PutRolePolicy"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"DateGreaterThan": {"aws:CurrentTime": "2026-08-06T08:30:00Z"}} }] }
```

Will replace with least-privilege deny list and publish rollback steps.

Akira: KMS condition we plan: allow kms:Decrypt when kms:ViaService = "s3.amazonaws.com" AND aws:SourceAccount = "898989898989" (assessor). Also enforce encryption context keys to bind object id.

Maya: Platform will produce pt-readroom/snapshots/2188881234_window.tar.gz, object-locked, and publish pt-readroom/manifests/2188881234.sha256. Delivery via presigned GET valid 72h. SIEM alert snapshot included.

Jules: Oncall triage: who handles noisy scans or findings? Primary Sam, backup Akira. If a critical outage is discovered, escalate to incident bridge IR-2026.

Sam: I'll run a dry-run Wed to validate freeze + manifest export + checksum. Will include a smoke bundle.

Akira: I'll deploy decrypt-proxy to staging for the dry-run and capture CloudTrail entries so assessors activity shows under proxy role.

Maya: Ops: pause key rotations for alias/pt-readroom-key from 2026-08-06T06:00Z to 2026-08-06T20:00Z.

Infra Bot: Rotation pause scheduled for alias/pt-readroom-key during freeze window. Noted on SEC-PT-7340.

Jules: Acceptance criteria: add a one-liner to SEC-PT-7340 by EOD (examples: "Snapshot exported + sha256 verified", "Assessors only decrypt via proxy for designated prefixes"). Pre-check Fri 07:45 UTC 10m.

Sam: Added: "RBAC freeze applied + rollback tested."

Akira: Added: "KMS proxy active in staging; decrypts logged under proxy role."

Maya: Added: "Snapshot exported, object-lock in place, sha256 published."

Jules: Thanks team. Ping this thread for blockers or late scope changes. :white_check_mark:
